HolyWonders Affiliate Program

At Holy Wonders we believe that the best marketers are our happy customers! Therefore we welcome everyone who loves our products to become our affiliate and are happy to share the profits with you.

  • How it works?
  • How you’ll get paid? 
  • How to become an affiliate?
  • How to promote? Tips
  • Limitations

How it works?

After you register in a program, within short period of time we will review and approve you as an affiliate. 
You’ll get your affiliate link and a coupon code that will help to track your referrals.

Now you can tell your audience and friends about our product and share the affiliate link together with a coupon. Each time when someone makes a purchase with your coupon or this link you will earn a commission from the product price. 
We will make pay outs on 10th of the following month for the commission earned in the previous one.

We’ll provide you with some content pieces that you can integrate into your content or you can repost content from our accounts:
Inst -  https://www.instagram.com/holywonders.ca/ 
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@holywonders.ca

Note: if you repost our posts please make sure to also specify your promo code, otherwise people might follow the link in our account and you won’t get a referral bonus. If they use your promo code for the discount even if they didn’t follow your link, you’ll get the reward. 
In order to capture a referral bonus a customer must either use your link or a coupon code, at least one of these two options. 

If the customer followed your link and left the site, you still be able to get a bonus if he returns to the site on the same device and makes a purchase within 30 days while he still has a valid cookie stored from the time he followed your link. 

How you’ll get paid?

We will make pay outs on 10th of the following month for the commission earned in the previous using the payment method you specified during the registration. 

How to become an affiliate?

To become HolyWonders affiliate - you need to register in the program using the link: https://af.uppromote.com/holy-wonders/register .

How to promote? Tips and Cautions 

Important: Our product is designated for adults and it is not a toy for children as it contains small pieces and fragile glass items. Please do not promote the product for children.

We believe our HolyWonders DIY Christmas Kits help create perfect vibes for couple dates, home parties with friends and cozy chill evenings on your own, so you can try to suggesting these product uses to your audience and friends. 
Although, of course, we understand that you are the one who knows best what your audience likes and relates to, so feel free to adjust accordingly. You can browse our site for more inspiration: https://holywonders.shop/ . 


Limitations (year 2024)

  • Our product is designated for adults and it is not a toy for children as it contains small pieces and fragile glass items. Please do not promote the product for children.
  •  Currently we only sell and ship within Canada, although in the future we aim to expand to US.  
  • This year (2024) is our first year and we have a limited supply of product items, only 200 boxes for sale. That means after all boxes will be sold out you won’t be able to earn more commissions as there would be no more sale from this moment.
  • Also this year (2024) we unfortunately have limited preproduction samples, so we won’t be able to send you a product in advance for you to shoot it. However, you can still use our pieces of content that we provide for your edits or reposts our publications. Finally, you can also choose purchase the product yourself for your content needs (and fun) using your affiliate link and coupon, and you’ll earn your commission on this purchase as well. You can always contact us to try to negotiate special arrangements.
